Hi Adithya,

Not sure if it is related but I recently received a question about loading the Python models and I corresponded with Kalaivani about it. This is what she replied:

I tried loading the Zenodo files using the joblib package and I was able to load them correctly (Please see screenshot below). Loading the files using pickle gives some error. Scikit-learn seems to recommend using joblib to dump and load classifiers and we have used the same in our code. I am using scikit-learn v0.22.1 and Python 3.8. Hope this helps.



Maybe good if you could first try to check that this step works for you. Next, step could be to run the models from within R.

Note that I am not actively maintaining the code and I have not recently used it.

Best regards,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
